SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME, KEY_1 AS LEGACY_PO_NO, KEY_2 AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, KEY_3 AS LEGACY_GR_NO FROM FM.MROSENDINFO WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','X')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'KBRC' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(B.STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, ISNULL(A.KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, '001' AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(A.KEY_2,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, 'KRW' AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(B.UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(B.GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(B.GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),B.GR_DATE,25),'-','') AS GR_DATE, ISNULL(B.LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(A.KEY_3,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, '001' AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ISNULL(B.DELY_TO_LOCATION,' ') AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, 0 AS RO_QTY, 0 AS RO_AMT, ' ' AS REMARK FROM FM.MROSENDINFO A, FM.V_FMMATSTOINFO B WHERE A.DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND A.KEY_10 IN (' ','X') AND A.KEY_1 = B.LEGACY_PO_NO AND A.KEY_2 = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.KEY_3 = B.LEGACY_GR_NO AND A.KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND A.KEY_2 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' AND A.KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' ORDER BY A.KEY_1, A.KEY_2, A.KEY_3
UPDATE FM.MROSENDINFO SET KEY_10 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND KEY_10 IN (' ','X') AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.BUYER_ITEM_NO$' AND KEY_3 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$'
